title: Operator approval claims (approval/1, DEC-0039)
description: The decoded payload of an approval: a compact JWS by the estate key (alg EdDSA, typ fabric-approval+jwt) that one person of the estate approved one action for one callee. The protected header is $defs/header.

iss.description: The estate hub that signed the approval.

actionDigest.description: sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the action.

aud.description: The one callee that may act on it.

approver.description: The person of the estate who approved.

method.description: prompt: in Fabric; operator-channel: the operator channel's confirm token (DEC-0034 OC-6); device: a device check.
